texts: good. the thirty lanterns become one counted group of thirty placed in the Northcove, plus a fireable rule that puts each individual lantern there too, so both "how many lanterns?" and "is this lantern in the Northcove?" resolve. "Stand in" is correctly recorded as a static position rather than an event, which is what the sentence means. Northcove is kept as a name with no separate "cove" type atom, which is the right conservative reading — the sentence never states what kind of place it is.
